title: JSFL drawing state: setFillColor, setStrokeColor, setStrokeSize, setStrokeStyle
description:
Add drawing tool state to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts so scripted shape creation respects color/stroke settings.

1. Add runtime state: _currentFillColor: string = '#000000', _currentStrokeColor: string = '#000000', _currentStrokeSize: number = 1, _currentStrokeStyle: string = 'solid' to the state object (or as local variables in makeDocumentProxy closure).

2. doc.setFillColor(colorString: string): sets _currentFillColor, return void. Flash passes '#RRGGBB' strings.

3. doc.setStrokeColor(colorString: string): sets _currentStrokeColor, return void.

4. doc.setStrokeSize(size: number): sets _currentStrokeSize, return void.

5. doc.setStrokeStyle(style: string): sets _currentStrokeStyle ('solid', 'dashed', etc.), return void.

6. Update addNewOval and addNewRectangle to USE _currentFillColor and _currentStrokeColor when calling createOvalShape/createRectShape (currently they use hardcoded defaults). Pass _currentFillColor as the fill color and _currentStrokeColor + _currentStrokeSize as stroke params.

7. Add getters doc.fillColor, doc.strokeColor, doc.strokeSize so scripts can read back the current state.

Add all to JsflDocument interface.
